aggregation: Each of three processes retains ten matched request ratios per interface. GM is across requests within a process; process range is not a confidence interval. No mixing with historical main66.

contract_interpretation.primary_comparison: Within each interface, compare Dao/cuButterfly with the same result lifetime.
contract_interpretation.cross_interface_limit: Native-return retains twenty independently allocated captured outputs; supplied-output repeatedly writes one caller buffer. Working set and cache behavior therefore differ. Cross-interface differences cannot be attributed entirely to the Dao copy.
contract_interpretation.event_boundary: GPU complete transform and interface operations. Host allocation, planning, compilation, capture and checking excluded.
contract_interpretation.graph_lifetime: Each native-return call owns a distinct result inside the twenty-call capture. Replaying the graph reuses those private addresses; it does not allocate fresh user outputs across replays.
contract_interpretation.working_set_boundary: Reported result-buffer bytes only. Input, plan workspace, backend scratch and allocator pool overhead are excluded; Dao supplied-output has backend temporary allocation of unmeasured captured live footprint.
contract_interpretation.historical_limit: Current775a independent cohort, not a rewrite or direct copy-cost subtraction from historical main66 1.474x.

reference_continuity.note: Historical error arrays flatten logical values; compare flattened current references without changing values.
